Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rehearsal windows + travel buffer — proposed cadence

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the outline on the on-site agenda. We want to lock down two things this week: (1) a short executive rehearsal (30–45m) that aligns EMEA execs and our APAC stakeholders before the main workshop, and (2) a travel/arrival buffer so the Redwoods team isn't rushed into the first full day.

Constraints: our EMEA leadership is only available 14:00–17:00 BST (their local) the week of Apr 19; our APAC directors can join early in the morning Pacific time (06:00–09:00 PT) which overlaps just at the start of EMEA afternoon.

Can you propose a rehearsal cadence that:
- keeps the session to 45 minutes max
- includes time for the execs to preview the 45m opening deck and 10m Q&A
- gives your on-site engineers a 6–8 hour travel buffer before Day 1 (they fly in from SEA overnight)

I attached a draft agenda and a short travel constraints XLSX (flight/visa notes). Prefer to have a confirmed slot and travel buffer by EOD Mon, Apr 5.

Thanks,
Avery

--

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rehearsal windows + travel buffer — proposed cadence

Avery — thanks for the clarity and the files. Quick take below and a proposed schedule.

High level approach:
- Keep exec rehearsal strictly 30–40m: 20m walkthrough (opening deck + success metrics), 10–15m clarifying Q&A, 5m landing + action items.
- Run the rehearsal as a "late EMEA / early PT" overlap at 15:00 BST which is 07:00 PT — that gives APAC attendees an early start but still within their morning window.
- For travel buffer, we recommend all on-site engineers land no later than 24 hours before Day 1 start to allow hardware checks and a 2–3 hour dry run. For cross-APAC legs, an overnight flight arriving in the morning of Day -1 works best.

Proposed slots (week of Apr 19):
- Exec rehearsal: Wed Apr 21, 15:00–15:40 BST (07:00–07:40 PT)
- Technical dry run (internal): Wed Apr 21, 09:00–11:00 local venue time (engineers only)
- Day 1 start: Thu Apr 22, 09:30 local time — which means engineers should arrive by Wed morning (24+ hour buffer).

I've looped in Marcus and Grace for logistics + travel coordination. If those windows look tight for your execs, we can shift rehearsal to Tue Apr 20, same times.

Next steps: Marcus will send a calendar hold for the rehearsal + dry run. Grace will confirm lodging block and local transport.

Best,
Priyom

--
